description: Dates that apply to every applicant in a cycle (specs/planner/timeline.md "The cycle file"). One object per cycle, named by the academic year in which students apply. Reviewed in a data PR each spring when the next cycle's dates are published; checked by scripts/check-cycle.mts (npm run verify). Fixed federal and national dates first; windows, test dates, and the summer list are added by the timeline unit.
